description:
Probe on develop 01e69178a (release, interp and run agree), b = <<65, 255, 66>>, against Elixir 1.19.4:
- String.upcase(b): Elixir returns b unchanged; fz panics 'case mapping expects valid UTF-8' at runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:1007 and aborts the process. downcase and capitalize share the path and were not probed.
- String.reverse(b): Elixir <<65, 255, 66>>; fz <<255, 66, 65>> (reverses bytes).
- String.codepoints(b): Elixir ["A", <<255>>, "B"]; fz ["A", <<255, 66>>].
- IO.puts(b): Elixir raises ArgumentError; fz writes the raw bytes.
- @doc "a\xFFb" (reachable once PR #510 lands): error[internal/post-resolution-leftover] 'quoted function decode failed: expected valid UTF-8 bitstring', an internal-class error with no source span; it should be a spanned diagnostic.
- String.to_charlist/1 is not exported.
Scratch: scratchpad/xxd16/{up,rev,cp,puts}.fz and e.exs.
Fails before, passes after: oracle fixtures for upcase/downcase/capitalize, reverse and codepoints on an invalid binary on all three paths; a diagnostic fixture for @doc. IO.puts raising depends on exceptions (fz-3ul).
Acceptance: full gate green; no pin rises unexplained.
title: String functions on a binary that is not valid UTF-8 answer as Elixir does
